newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel slides with NYMEX, traders await APIs.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel slides with NYMEX, traders await APIs.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell over 1.50 cents a gallon with NYMEX Tuesday, but differentials held steady as traders awaited API inventory data later today.
Gulf Coast prompt back 30th cycle 54-grade fuel was talked 2.75 cents below November futures, steady with Monday diffs, with low-sulfur 55-grade sold for 2.10 cents under.
New York Harbor 54-grade was pegged at 1.10 cents over November futures, with 55-grade unchanged at 1.75 cents over.
"It's a bit slow; we're waiting for the APIs," a Gulf trader said, noting previous weekly data showed high production of 1.36 million barrels per day of jet fuel.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
